tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// nye brgyud tshe rta zung 'brel 'chi med dpal ster gyi sgrub thabs dbang chog man ngag dang bcas pa bzhugs so// grub chen thang rgyal lugs// ༄༅// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'gro kun rjes su skyong*// tshe dpag med mgon 'gro la 'chi med ster// rta mgrin dbang rgyal 'gro ba'i bar chad sel// pad+ma 'byung gnas snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs// thang stong rgyal por gsol btab slu ba med// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi puṇ+ye dz+nyā na ā yuḥsid+dhi dzaḥ zhes dbang bskur bas gnas skabs su tshe'i bar chad zhi zhing*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob nas/ mthar thug bde ba can gyi zhing du skye bar 'gyur ro// rje grub chen gyi gsung gtsang ma'o// ༈ /tshe sgrub nye brgyud 'chi med dpal ster bzhugs// na mo gu ru bīr+ya bha drā ya/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sa phyogs thams cad bai ḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi la gser gyi mig mangs ris su bris pa'i dbus su rma bya chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri/ pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa/ ral pa'i thor cog dang dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od zer kun nas 'bar ba'i skur gyur ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad tshe dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu bla ma brgyud pa tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bla tshe 'thor ba dang yar ba rnams bsdus/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams la thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi bcud/ nang bcud kyi sems can gyi tshe dang bsod nams/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi yon tan nus pa thams cad bsdus gong bzhin bstim/ mthar bla ma brgyud pa'i sku las 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas lus thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi dkar pos khengs/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma puṇ+ye dz+nyā na ā yuḥsid+dhi dzaḥ zhes bzla/ 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*// rig pa'i blo dang rnam dpyod shes rab dang*// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa /de kun lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// dpon slob mi 'bral lhan cig 'grogs// sku tshe mi 'gyur sra zhing brtan// ja bzang bzhes spro rgyun mi chad// skyid la chos 'phel bkra shis shog /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ slob ma yang slob dpon gyis nyams su blang bya ltar/ tshe dpag med longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bskyed/ de'i spyi gtsug tu tho brtsegs su bla ma brgyud pa rnams bskyed/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bla tshe 'thor ba/ yar ba/ nyams pa sogs bsdus/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams la thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi bcud/ nang bcud kyi sems can gyi tshe dang bsod nams/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi byin rlabs bsdus gong bzhin bstim/ mthar bla ma brgyud pa'i sku las 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun dkar po babs/ slob ma'i lus kyi nang gang*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ

snang ba mtha' yas sogs brjod la/ dbang bskur/ 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*/ zhes sogs kyis tshe chang tshe ril sbyin/ dpon slob mi 'bral sogs kyi shis pa brjod/ rjes bla ma brgyud pa rim par 'od du zhu/ gcig la gcig thim pa slob ma la bstims pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam mo// ༈ /bla ma zhi khro'i tshe sgrub dang tshe dbang skur tshul gyi cho ga 'chi med rdo rje'i rgya mdud ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med pa dang*// dbyer med bla ma mchog la gus btud nas// tshe rta zung 'brel 'chi med dpal ster gyi// phyag len bklags chog bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri// de la 'dir tshe rta zung 'brel 'chi med dpal ster bla ma zhi khro'i tshe sgrub rang nyid nyams su len pa dang*/ gzhan la tshe dbang byed tshul ni/ gnas khang yid dang mthun par/ tshe dpag med kyi rten bris 'bur gang rigs kyi mdun du/ stegs kyi khar ras sogs gzhi gtsang ma'i steng du nas kyi tshom bu pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi tshul du bkod/ de'i steng du mañji'i khar tshe bum rta mgo can/ g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang ka ra dang sbyar ba/ tshe bum gyi g.yas su tshe dpag med kyi gtor ma zlum po dmar po theb kyu bzhis brgyan pa/ g.yon du mkha' 'gro spyi gtor de bas chung tsam zlum gtor dmar po theb kyu bzhis brgyan pa/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga sbreng tshar/ gzhan yang sngon 'gro'i gtor ma zlum gtor chung ngu gcig slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod/ 'thor nas/ thun dong*/ nas 'bo gang la tshe mda' dar tshon sna lnga tshe g.yu me long chung ngu btags pa phyag len bzhin bshams la/ cho ga dngos la 'jug pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la chab bran te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥlan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'byung po bgegs kyi rigs rnams ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes bkug la/ oṃ lo ka pā la ma hā bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis bsngo/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di phyogs skyong bcu lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang 'chi med tshe dbang zab mo sgrub par byed pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod/ oṃ muḥzhes gshegs su gsol/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la dga' ba'i bgegs rigs gdug pa can gsang spyod la lta bar mi dbang ba rnams gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig sum+bha brjod/ gnas yo byin rlabs ni/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi tshar gsum brjod/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi'o// rang sems stong gsal chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// ci nus dang*/

bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyi bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du tshe sgrub zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od 'phros/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la/ oṃ gu ru ā yur+dz+nyā na a pa ri mi ta sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ zhes phyag 'tshal/ na mo gu ru ā yur+dz+nyā na a pa ri mi ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ bdag mdun gnyis ka tha mi dad du lhar gsal 'debs bzhin pas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid gnas pa'i zhing 'di sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa bai ḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba/ bkod pas legs par mdzes shing lhun stug pa'i dbus su rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdamar po de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan dkyus ring zhing spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shing zhal 'dzum pa longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i tshe'i bum pa 'dzin pa/

ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba'i skur gyur pa'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang bsod nams rin chen/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang*/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu rdo ring kun spangs chen po/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas/ de'i dbu'i gtsug tu bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa khro bo'i rnam pa can spyi gtsug tu rta mgo ljang gus mtshan pa/

phyag g.yas thod dbyug dkar po nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ phyag g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang*/ dur khrod chas brgyad kyis sku la brgyan pa de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu mgon po tshe dpag med/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu chos sku snang ba mtha' yas rnams phyag mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'chi med tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i so so'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i steng gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang*/ rang nyid la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ de la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'am/ dril gsil gang rigs byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'gro kun rjes su skyong*// tshe dpag med mgon 'gro la 'chi med ster// rta mgrin dbang rgyal 'gro ba'i bar chad sel// pad+ma 'byung gnas snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs// thang stong rgyal por gsol btab slu ba med// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// mkhas btsun grub pa'i sar bzhugs kun spangs rje// 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog zhabs// dpal ldan grub rig 'dzin pa nyi zla'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// 'chi med grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang phyug dpal// 'chi med brnyes pa ngag dbang chos grags zhabs// rgyal sras spyan snga kun dga' don grub la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams dang*/

kha skong*/ /'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs// rig 'dzin brnyes pa kun dga' bkra shis la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// ngag gi dbang po bsod nams rin chen dang*// bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' blo gros zhabs// mkhas shing grub brnyes nam mkha' 'chi med la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// rdo rje 'chang dngos kun dga' bstan 'dzin sogs// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam zhi khro chos skyong srung ma la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi puṇ+ye dz+nyā na ā yuḥsid+dhi dzaḥ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyi sku lus las 'od zer 'phros snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas rang dang bsgrub gzhan la dbang skur ba'i tshe/ bya'i bla tshe yar ba dang 'thor ba/ nyams chags su gyur pa rnams dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe dpal bsod nams/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ nyan rang chos srung sogs 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bcud dang dge mtshan rnams bsdus/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la thim/ slar yang de dag gi sku lus las 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang dang bsgrub bya'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad bdud rtsis khyab pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ ces dmigs pa'i dus tshe bcud tshe ril la yang bstims la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi puṇ+ye dz+nyā na ā yuḥsid+dhi dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags ci nus bzlas la/ tshe 'gugs ni/ rdor dril mda' dar 'dzin pas/ hrīḥ dkar mo mgyogs ma zhi ba'i las mdzad ma// rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum dang bcas// tshe bdag chen mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis// rdo rje'i tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig

/oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ hrīḥ ser mo mgyogs ma rgyas pa'i las mdzad ma// rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum dang bcas// tshe bdag chen mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis// rdo rje'i tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig /oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ hrīḥ dmar mo mgyogs ma dbang sdud las mdzad ma// pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum dang bcas// tshe bdag chen mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis// rdo rje'i tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig /oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ hrīḥ sngon mo mgyogs ma drag po'i las mdzad ma// las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum dang bcas// tshe bdag chen mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis// rdo rje'i tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig /oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ zhes mgyogs ma bzhi'i tshe 'gugs byas la/ thal mo sbyar te/ ngag tu/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yis// mthu dang nus pa'i byin rlabs dpung bskyed nas// 'gal rkyen nad gdon sdig sgrib byang ba dang*// tshe dang ye shes 'chi med dngos grub stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas 'od du zhu/ mgon po tshe dpag med la thim/ de rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po la thim/ de slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas la thim/ de grub chen thang stong rgyal po la thim/ de rdo ring kun spangs chen po la thim/ de rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog la thim/ de bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po la thim/ de mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang la thim/ de mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags la thim/ de spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub la thim/ de dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la thim/ de dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug la thim/

de dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis la thim/ de dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang bsod nams rin chen la thim/ de dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros la thim/ de mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med la thim/ de mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin la thim/ de rang tshe dpag med du gsal ba la thim pas 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*// rig pa'i blo dang rnam dpyod shes rab dang*// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa// de kun lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// ces 'dod gsol bya/ 'di yan rgyun gyi nyams len no/ gtor ma la chab bran la/ dang po tshe dpag med la 'bul te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga rnams bskol zhing zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes pa'i sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs rnams mchod sbyin gtor ma'i mgron du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim par bsams la/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam lngas gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar brjod/ ḍā dril dang bcas pas ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi tshar gcig brjod pas phyi mchod/ nang mchod 'thor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed du// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod// spro na/ tshe dpag med mgon 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ phaiṃ badz+ra ā ra l+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan lnga'am gsum gyis bsngo/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes nang mchod gtor/ ḍā dril gsil zhing*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod la/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bar chad zhi zhing mthun rkyen yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i grogs mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod/ de yan gyis slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rim pa rnams bstan zin to// slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni/ gral la 'khod de chab dang me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la/ don nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan pa gnang bar zhu/

de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gdul bya so so'i khams dang bsam pa dang*/ bag la nyal dang rjes su mthun par chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad bsdu na/ theg pa dman pa dang*/ theg pa chen po gnyis su 'dus pa las/ theg pa chen po yin/ theg pa chen po la yang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa rnam pa gnyis su yod pa las/ sngags kyi theg pa yin/ de la yang gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis su yod pa las/ rnying ma'i lugs yin/ de la rgya che ba bka' ma dang*/ nye brgyud gter ma dang*/ zab mo dag snang ma'i chos sde tshan gsum du yod pa las/ 'dir ni gter ma dang*/ dag snang ma zung du 'brel ba'i smin byed kyi tshe dbang zab mo 'bul ba'i skabs su babs pa yin te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam// sangs rgyas byang chub bstan pa'i mchog /ces gsungs pas smin grol so so'i sgo nas tshe sring ba'i thabs mang du gsungs pa'i nang nas skabs su babs pa ni/ rgyal ba yongs kyi phrin las pa chen po grub chen thang stong rgyal po zhes bya ba de nyid ni/ o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis tswa ri zil chen gsang phug tu zab gter sbed par mdzad pa grub chen rang gis gter nas bzhes pa'i lung bstan kun gsal me long las/ zhi ba thugs rje chen po dang*// drag po khro rgyal rta mgrin gnyis// dbyer med gcig tu sprul pa las// sku yi cha lugs zhi ma khro// mdog smug dri zhim sme bas brgyan// ngang rgyud dal zhing rig rtsal che// ma nges spyod pa sna tshogs skyong*// nang rtags ya mtshan ston pa 'byung*/ zhes dang*/ gzhan nas kyang 'ol ba zhes bya'i shar mdun du// brtson 'grus zhes bya'i ming can 'byung*// de ni nga yi thugs sprul yin// zhes sogs gter kha tha dad nas lan gcig ma yin par lung bstan pa de nyid la/

ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro sde lngas mtshan re re phul ba'i dang po ni/ khyab brdal chen po'i thang chen na// stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'jigs med rgyal po lta bur bzhugs// de phyir thang stong rgyal por thogs// zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa de nyid dang*/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas gnyis gdul bya dag pa'i snang ngor dbye ba med kyang*/ gzhan snang du o rgyan chen po dang zhal kyang lan mang du mjal/ lhag par thugs nyams dang mnal lam lta bu ma yin par/ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor pho brang chen por sku dngos su byon nas/ o rgyan chen po dang zhal mjal bas/ o rgyan chen po he ru ka'i chas kyi rnam par bzhugs nas/ sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas dbang bskur mdzad pas/ lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal gzigs shing*/ gzhan yang dbang dang gdams pa mtha' yas pa gsan/ ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa la o rgyan chen pos zhu ba po'i tshul mdzad de rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa gsan pa yin te/ rnam thar gsol 'debs las/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du phebs pa'i tshe// pad+ma 'byung gnas rgyal po'i cha lugs can// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro du mas bskor ba la// sgrub chen bka' brgyad la sogs gsan la 'dud// sangs rgyas stong sogs yi dam du ma gzigs// khyad par ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' la// o rgyan chen pos zhu ba mdzad byas nas// bla med rdzogs pa chen po gsan la 'dud// ces bya ba ltar yin la/ slar yang o rgyan chen pos grub chen nyid bod yul du 'gro ba'i don la 'byon dgos par bkas bskul ba ni/ chos skal gter lnga bod na yod// gdul bya rnam thar bod du langs// zhes pa dang*/ sa 'brug dbyar zla dang po'i tshes bcu la// sa yi me btsa' rten 'brel bsgrig dgos yod// 'gyangs na chu shor zin pa'i rags dang 'dra// sngas na ri dwags ma tshud rgya dang 'dra// rig pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu phan sems can// slar yang bod yul kha ba can du bzhud// ces gsungs pa la brten nas grub chen nyid bod yul du byon te/

sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa dang*/ gru lcags zam pa 'dzugs pa sogs 'gro don dge la rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa ston par sus kyang 'gran par mi nus pa kun gyi spyod yul du gyur pa 'di rnams lags/ zab gter kyang lnga tsam spyan 'dren pa'i tshul bstan pa'i nang nas da lam bla ma zhi khro'i tshe'i dbang bskur ba zab mo yin/ 'di lta bu'i zab lam la brten nas grub chen nyid kyis dgung lo brgya dang nyer lnga bzhugs/ bgrang bar mi nus pa'i slob ma rnams smin grol la 'god par mdzad cing*/ de dag gi nang nas chos rje mang yul ba 'phags pa blo gros kyis dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu bzhugs/ khams rdo gog dgon dang nye bar bzhugs pa'i rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma grub chen gyi dngos slob yin pa gcig gis lo brgya dang sum cu bzhugs/ 'tsho sgo ba'i bla ma gcig gis lo brgya dang bcu gnyis bzhugs/ yang khams na grub chen gyi dngos slob gcig gis lo brgya phrag kha yar brgal bar bzhugs pa sogs/ grub chen nyid sku tshe la mnga' brnyes pa'i rten 'brel gyis slob ma yang sku tshe la dbang 'byor pa mang du byon pa'i byin rlabs can de nyid kyi tshe dbang zab mo 'bul bar byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba gnyis su yod pa las/ slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag mdun lhan cig tu bsgrubs nas tshe 'gugs shing bzlas pa bya ba/ slar bdag mdun so sor phye nas mdun bskyed la gtor ma 'bul ba/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ mkha' 'gro spyi la gtor ma 'bul ba rnams da lan nas kyi gnas skabs su legs par grub zin nas/ da slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i rim pa yin/ de la yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba'i rim pa la maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa tha mi dad pa'i spyan sngar tshe dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/

de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ phyag me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// nas/ mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyis bskor ba sprin gyi phung po 'thibs pa ltar mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ khyed rang rnams kyis sku tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas/ khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur ba dang*/ 'chi med tshe sgrub pa la bar chad sel ba'i phyir thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon rang nyid skad cig gis rta mgrin dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar/ g.yas ljang*/ g.yon dkar ba/ spyi gtsug tu rta mgo gsum gyis mtshan pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brjes pa/ phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ral gri/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub/ mdung thung*/ rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ zhabs brgyad sbrul brgyad kyi steng na bgrad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ zhal re re bzhin spyan gsum gsum pa/ mi mgo skam rlon stag sham sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can du lam gyis gsal ba'i/ sku gsung thugs kyi gnas dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rang 'dra ba'i khro bo sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba til 'bru tsam/ yang chung rdul phran tsam sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad khengs pa tsam du byung ste/ khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur ba dang 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad skad cig gis phyi'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/

rol mo dang bcas pas thun rdeg cing*/ oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sum+bha sogs brjod la bgegs bskrad/ de nas 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba dang*/ drwa ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur pa la/ slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur ba dang*/ 'chi med tshe sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad nas/ dbang gi dngos gzhi'i slad du thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon gyis oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas snang grags kyi chos thams cad stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gnas pa'i zhing 'di sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa zhes pa nas gzi 'od 'bar ba'i skur gyur pa'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu da lta dbang skur mkhan gyi bla ma/ de'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang sogs nas tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin brjod la/ de la gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig byas pas/ de dag gi sku lus las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ khyad par nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams na bzhugs pa'i mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa dang*/ steng phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po dang*/

lho nub dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas na bzhugs pa'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa mdor na tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ drang srong gi tshogs rnams dang*/ bye brag tu bla ma zhi khro'i tshe'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku'i rnam pa/ che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba nyungs 'bru tsam/ yang chung rdul phran tsam dpag tu med pa byung nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i sgo/ ba spu'i bu ga dbang po'i sgo rnams nas/ rdo tsha mo la kha ba babs pa'am/ rgya mtsho chen po la char babs pa bzhin sib sib thim pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru sogs nas sad+dhi dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes yang yang brjod/ de nas tshe 'gugs ni/ bla mas rdor dril mda' dar 'dzin cing*/ dbyangs rol dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ hrīḥ dkar mo mgyogs ma zhi ba'i las mdzad ma// zhes sogs mgyogs ma bzhi'i tshe 'gugs gong ltar bya zhing*/ de nas khyed rang rnams tshe'i bcud bsdu ba'i slad du thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ spyi bo'i steng gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang*/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po dud pa zhig byas pas/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la khyab pas/ de dag na gnas pa'i sde brgyad ma rungs pa rnams kyis khyed rang rnams kyi bla tshe brkus pa/ khyer ba/ yar ba/ nyams chag tu gyur pa rnams dang*/ ban bon mthu bo che rnams kyi sngags dang*/ rdzas dang*/ bsam gtan gyi sbyor bas tshe srog 'phrog pa thams cad khab len gyi rdos lcags phye bsdus pa ltar rang dbang med par bkug ste spyi bo'i bla ma rnams dang*/

slob dpon gyi phyag gi tshe bum nang du zhugs par gyur/ de bzhin du 'od zer des 'byung ba bzhi'i khams thams cad la khyab pas ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ gser gyi ri bdun/ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ khor yug lcags kyi ri bo na gnas pa'i sa'i bcud sra zhing 'thas pa thams cad dang*/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ gaṅgā la sogs pa'i chu bo/ chu klung*/ khron pa/ chu mig la sogs 'og gzhi chu'i dkyil 'khor la thug gi bar gyi chu'i bcud mnyen lcug 'khril ldem la sogs pa thams cad dang*/ rta gdong gi me dang*/ khyim gyi me dang*/ sreg pa'i me dang*/ brdabs pa dang*/ gtsubs pa las byung ba'i me'i rgyun dang*/ nyi zla nor bu'i 'od la sogs pa me'i bcud drod dang*/ bkrag mdangs gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang*/ 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog pas ldegs ldem 'thor spyod kyi las byed pa'i rlung dang*/ skye 'gro'i lus la gnas pa'i las dang*/ ye shes kyi rlung ste yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi bcud/ yang rtsal stobs dang ldan pa thams cad dang*/ bcud kyi sems can la phog pas/ skye 'gro thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang mkhyen ldan gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ stobs ldan gyi rgyal po dang*/ mthu ldan gyi rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i mkhyen brtse nus stobs gzi brjid thams cad dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan sogs/ de dag thams cad 'od zer kha dog lnga'i rnam par bkug cing spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i bla ma rnams dang slob dpon gyi phyag gi tshe bum nang du zhugs/ de la khyed rang rnams kyis gus 'dud drag pos mos gus dung pa zhig byas pa la brten nas bum pa'i bdud rtsi khol zhing lud/ bla ma rnams kyi sku lus las kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/

gzhan du bo zegs med par khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang khengs/ rtsa khams thams cad la khyab pas 'chi ba med pa'i tshe/ rgud pa med pa'i lang tsho/ rtag brtan gzhom gzhig dang bral ba mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces tshe bum mgo thog tu 'jog cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas sogs nas/ yi dam zhi khro chos skyong srung ma la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi puṇ+ye dz+nyā na ā yuḥsid+dhi dzaḥ zhes sngags dang bcas dbang bskur/ tshe ril ster zhing*/ bkra shis tshe zan dpal gyi zas// snying po 'dus pa'i bcud 'di ni// de ring bu yis bza' bar bya// 'di zos bcom ldan tshe dpag med// zhal mthong 'gyur ba gdon mi za// tshe chang blud cing*/ 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*// rig pa'i blo dang rnam dpyod shes rab dang*// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa// de kun lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// me tog gtor la/ dpon slob mi 'bral lhan cig 'grogs// sku tshe mi 'gyur sra zhing brtan// ja chang bzhes spro rgyun mi chad// skyid la chos 'phel bkra shis shog /brgya tshar byed na/ slar yang thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ spyi bo'i steng gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang*/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig byas pas/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi bla tshe yar ba/ 'thor ba/ nyams pa mtha' dag dang*/ rgyu 'byung ba bzhi/ 'bras bu 'byung ba las gyur pa'i snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dpal bsod nams sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus te/

mgon po tshe dpag med rnams kyi phyag gi bum pa'i nang du zhugs/ de nyid 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsir khol zhing lud/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug nas mar zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig bgegs dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad sbyangs/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob byung snyam du mos pa mdzod/ tshe bum mgo thog tu bzhag oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'gro kun rjes su skyong*// tshe dpag med mgon 'gro la 'chi med ster// rta mgrin dbang rgyal 'gro ba'i bar chad sel// pad+ma 'byung gnas snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs// thang stong rgyal por gsol btab slu ba med// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi puṇ+ye dz+nyā na ā yuḥsid+dhi dzaḥ zhes brjod la tshe bum mgo thog tu bzhag bkra shis tshe zan sogs kyis tshe ril dang*/ 'chi med tshe yi sogs kyis tshe chang sbyin/ me tog gtor la/ dpon slob mi 'bral sogs kyi bkra shis brjod la grangs gsog brgya tshar sogs song ba'i rjes ma la gong gi brgyud 'debs rgyas pa yongs rdzogs dang tshe ril tshe chang bkra shis sogs 'dra/ de nas khyed rang rnams thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ spyi bo'i steng gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig byas pas/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas 'od du zhu/ mgon po tshe dpag med la thim/ zhes pa nas/ de mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin la thim/ de da ltar dbang skur mkhan gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de khyed rang rnams mgon po tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba la thim pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'chi med tshe'i dpal la longs spyod cing*/ sogs dang*/ dpon slob mi 'bral sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/

des dbang gi dngos gzhi legs par song nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams tshul bzhin du srung sdom byed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// lan gsum/ tshe dbang zab mo thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas slar yang lus longs spyod kyi thog nas gang mkho ba spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// lan gsum/ de ltar na dpal grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal pos slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la dngos su gsan pa'i bla ma zhi khro'i tshe'i dbang bskur ba zab mo legs par gsan pa yin pas 'di'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen por mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod do// rjes ni mchod pa rnams zhal gso/ gong gnas yo'i skabs ltar byin gyis brlab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma maṇ+ḍal la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'thor/ phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// sogs sh+lo ka gcig gis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// nas/ 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag nyid la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gyur gyis srung ba dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas sogs bsngo smon bkra shis rgyas par bya/

rgyun gyi nyams len la bdag bskyed rkyang pas 'thus/ bsnyen pa byed na thun bzhir bya zhing*/ sngags 'bum phrag bcu bzla'o// tshe bum sogs bca' gzhi slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba bzhin sgrub rdzas bsags la bsgrub pa phyag len lags/ grol nyin tshe bum mgo bor bzhag tshe ril tshe chang rang gi khar myangs nas dngos grub blang ngo*// de ltar slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal pos dngos su gsan pa'i 'chi med nye brgyud tshe rta zung 'brel 'chi med dpal ster bla ma zhi khro'i tshe sgrub rang gi nyams len dang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga lag len snyan brgyud bklag chog tu bkod pa 'di ni/ slob ma'i mchog gdong kha dpon slob bsod nams chos 'phel gyis nan tan du bskul ba'i ngor sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyis 'di'i skor la nges shes khyad par can yod cing mi 'jigs pa'i gdengs dang ldan pas/ lha chen phun tshogs gling du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bsod nams tshe ring gis gus spro'i sgo nas bris pa dge zhing 'chi med rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig

'di'i gong 'og gi brgyud pa'i kha skong rnams 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa'o/ //dge legs 'phel// ༈ /nye brgyud tshe rta zung 'brel gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi gsal byed snying por dril ba 'chi med dga' ston ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ 'chi med tshe dang ye shes mchog stsol ba'i// bla ma zhi khro'i tshogs la gus btud nas// de nyid bsnyen cing sgrub las grub gnyis kyi// dga' ston skal bzang ring 'tsho'i cho ga dbye// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal o ḍī yā na'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang dbyer ma mchis pa 'chi med grub pa thang stong rgyal po'i zhal snga nas nye bar 'ongs pa'i bla ma zhi khro'i tshe sgrub zab mo la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis bde blag tu 'grub par 'dod pa dag gis 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ bsnyen sgrub la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba/ zhugs pa'i nyams len dngos/ zhugs 'bras rang gzhan la phan gdags pa'i tshul lo// dang po la gnyis/ cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba'o// dang po ni/ 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur ba dang*/ gdams ngag gi lung thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa/ nges 'byung dang byang chub sems gnyis kyis rgyud legs par 'byongs shing*/ rang gzhan gyi don du 'chi med ye shes kyi sku myur du 'grub par 'dod pas spros med bdag bskyed kho na la brten yang rung mod/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na gnas khang mdzes par brgyan/ sku gsum tshe lha'i bris 'bur gyi rten yod na bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun stegs bu khebs ldan gyi dbus sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad ras bris bting ba'i lte bar me tog gi tshom bu gcig dgod/ de'i steng mañji'i rtser rin po che'am rdza la sogs pa'i snod du bum rdzas so lnga'i phye ma dang rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tshe ril bsres pa'i phye mar las tshe bum rtsa bar tshe ril phyur bur spungs pa'i tshul gyis bskor ba/

kha rgyan shing lo dang dpag bsam shing la rdo rje g.yung drung rgyal mtshan nyi zla sogs dang*/ bum pa'i kha'i mdun ngos su rta mgos mtshon pa dgod/ g.yas su mañji'i khar tshe ril mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i phye mar gyi ril bu'am/ rgyun ring 'jog na cong zhi mjo 'or 'dam btags legs par byas pa dang brag zhun ga bur bzang po drug rnams la gzhi byas/ a bar skyur gsum dang dbang lag sogs bcud len gyi sman gang 'dzom sbyar ba mngar gsum gyis bsdus pa la/ rje grub dbang gi tshe ril gyi phabs rgyun yod na shin tu legs shing*/ gang ltar yang sel med kyi tshe ril byin can gyi phabs dang ldan pas ril bu sran 'phos tsam mtshal lam tsan+dan gyis rtsi gsol te ril chags thob par byas pas thod pa mtshan ldan nam rin po che'i snod phyur bur bkang bar shog bu'am dar dmar gyi rdul khebs bya/ g.yon du stegs gang rung gi khar thod pa'am dkar yol lta bur chang gar bzang po'am chu gtsang la mngar gsum chos sman btab pa'i tshe chang dar dmar gyi khebs ldan/ mdun du 'das gtor zlum brjid pad 'dab bzhis bskor smug rtsi byugs pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma/ chos skyong gzhan yod na de'i gtor ma sogs phyag len bzhin bsham/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod g.yas skor ram g.yas nas brtsams thad bsgrigs gang bde/ rang gi stan gnas khang dang go yul 'grig na kha shar du phyogs par bting ba'i 'og sa dkar gyi g.yung drung chos skor du bri/ 'grub na stan dkar rdo rje'i ri mo can 'ding*/ mdun du lcog rtse'i khar rdor dril nang mchod ḍā ru me tog sngon 'gro gtor ma/ spos thun/ tshe mda' rgod sgro ma nyams par dar sna lnga'am dmar po g.yu dang me long btags pa sogs nyer mkho mtha' dag tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ dgongs mo'i char babs pa na stan la 'dug nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sogs chos spyod ci rigs pa sngon du 'gro bas/

oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum bzlas nas rang rta mgrin gyi skur lam gyis bsgoms la sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ drag sngags spos thun rol mo'i tsham rngams kyis bgegs bskrad/ sgo drung du tho dkar po brtsig spro na rgyal tho 'dzugs chog gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ gang ltar yang rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba gsal zhing brtan pa cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par bsgoms la mtshams gcad/ bsgom bzlas rgyas bsdus gang rigs cung zad byas la thun bsdu zhing nyal ba'i rnal 'byor sogs la 'jug go /gnyis pa nyams len dngos la/ tshe sgrub la shis pa'i gza' tshes bzang po'i thor thun nas dbu bzung ste/ 'jam mgon kun dga' bkra shis kyi gsung rab 'chi med rdo rje'i rgya mdud sogs rang gang mos kyi yig cha khungs thub ltar nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de'ang thun thams cad kyi mgor brgyud 'debs sngon du 'gro bas rang skad cig gis khro bo rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i tshogs dpag du med pa spros te bgegs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pas rta mgrin gyi sngags ci rigs pa brjod/ srung 'khor gsal 'debs skyor re bas na legs/ gang ltar yang gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams la dmigs te rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor zhing las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che dang zhes sogs 'don sgom sbrags mthar so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar ḍā dril 'khrol bzhin ghaṇ+ḍer tshar gsum brjod pa'i dang pos mchod yul rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i tshe de rnams kyis gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs par mos/ rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma sku dngos sam/ yang na tshe dpag med dam grub chen lcags zam pa'i rnam pa can skyabs gnas kun 'dus su bsgoms la skyabs 'gro ma nam mkha' ma lan gsum mam nyer gcig brjod/ skyabs yul rang la bstim/ smon 'jug gi don dran pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ rang skad cig gis tshe dpag med kyi skur gsal ba'i snying gar zla gdan la hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bde ba can dang pad+ma 'od nas rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i chos sku snang mtha'/ longs sku tshe dpag med dang rta mgrin/ sprul sku u rgyan chen po/ kun 'dus grub chen lcags zam pa rnams la sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ oṃ gu ru ā yur+dz+nyā na a pa ri mi ta sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍal le bh+yaḥ zhes brjod pas lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas phyag 'tshal bar bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo nam mkha' gang ba spros pas mchod par bsams la/ oṃ gu ru ā yur+dz+nyā na a pa ri mi ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ la sogs so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa brjod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags kyi tshig rkang dang pos rten gyi stobs sam tshogs zhing gsal gdab/ gnyis pas sdig pa bshags/ gsum pas rjes su yi rangs/ bzhi pas don dam byang sems/ lnga pa dang drug pas skyabs 'gro/ bdun pa dang brgyad pas smon sems/ dgu pa bcu pa bcu gcig pa rnams kyis 'jug pa sems bskyed/ tshig tha mas dge ba bsngo ba rnams kyi don nges pa'i sgo nas dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing gi thugs ka nas 'od zer byung*/

rang la phog pas rang dang tshogs zhing gnyis su med par bsams pa'i mthar tshogs zhing rang la bstim pa'am/ 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim par mos la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad la reg pas bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bde ba dang mi 'bral/ btang snyoms la gnas par bsam bzhin sems can thams cad bde ba dang zhes sogs brjod pas bsod nams dang*/ swa bhā wa'i sngags don rang bzhin dag pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin dag pa nga'o zhes chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa sems nyid 'od gsal ba'i gnas lugs la blo gzhag pas yi shes kyi tshogs bsags te/ rang sems lha'i skur hril gyis shar dus sgrub rdzas snod bcud du 'dzin pa'i rtog snang logs na med pa'i bdag mdun dbyer med blor shong na dang*/ de min kyang rang dang sgrub rdzas dbyer med ngo bo tshe lha'i sku gcig tu blos bsgom pa yin pas snod kyi 'jig rten 'di nyid bde ba can gyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa/ tha gru che ba ri rab khor yug gi ri dang rgya mtsho ngan song gi gnas sogs med pa sa gzhi thams cad bai ḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ spos kyi ngad ldang ba/ rin po che sna bdun gyi shing ljon pa dang*/ spos chu'i klung gi rgyun dang*/ pad+ma la sogs pa dang*/ sprul pa'i bya sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa/ gos dang rgyan dang gzhal med khang sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis 'byor pa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha dang mtshungs pa/ dus dus su lha'i me tog dang*/ spos chu'i char dang*/ rin po che sna bdun dang*/ tsan+dan gyi phye ma dang*/ lha'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gyi char 'bebs pa/ lha'i bla bre dang rnga yab sogs nam mkha' la 'dzin cing lha'i rol dbyangs kyi sgra sgrog cing*/ lha'i bu mo gar byed pa sogs bkod pa du mas khyad par 'phags pa der nyan thos dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'dus pa'i dbus na byang chub kyi shing dpag tshad stong drug brgya pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i drung du rma byas bteg pa'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la rang nyid hrīḥlas tshe dpag med du bskyed pa'i thugs kar zla gdan la hrīḥyig gi khog par tshe'i ngo bo 'od kyi thig le dkar 'tsher 'od lnga 'phro ba dang*/

dbu gtsug tu gang las brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs reg la ma 'byar ba'i tshul du bsgom/ de'ang rje btsun rdo rings pa man chad rab byung sngags 'chang gang yin de'i cha byad tshe bum bsnams pa'am/ yang na tshe dpag med kyi rnam pa/ rje grub chen rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs tshe bum can/ o rgyan chen po za hor ma/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub zhabs brgyad pa'am/ dkyus ltar sku mdog dmar po dbyug to sdigs mdzub dur khrod chas can/ tshe dpag med dang snang mtha' yongs grags ltar bsgom/ de nas bla ma de rnams so so'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang sogs skyabs yul thams cad spyan drangs te bla ma re rer yang cha tshang ba re thim pas bla ma de rnams skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam/ de rnams la bdag gi tshe'i bar chad bsal nas 'chi med kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol snyam pa'i dad gdung shugs drag pos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas sogs rtsa ba'i gsol 'debs sngags dang spel ba thun mgor brgya rtsa tsam brjod nas sngags kher rkyang bzla ba'am/ yang na thun mgo dang sngags stong phrag re song mtshams su bdun nam nyer gcig spel mar 'don pa gang bde bya/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma dam pa de rnams sangs rgyas rang snang la sems can gyi don mdzad mi mdzad kyi kun rtog mi mnga' yang*/ gdul bya'i snang ngor thugs rje lhag par g.yos te thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dang*/ 'od zer gyi drwa ba dang*/ 'od kyi zer thag sbubs can 'jigs rung lta bu sogs gsal zhing 'tsher ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ stong gsum rab 'byams mu mtha' med pa'i zhing khams thams cad la khyab pas bdag gi bla tshe 'phrog pa/ 'khyams pa/ yar ba/ 'thor ba/ brgyal zhing 'drogs pa/ 'chi bdag gshin rje sde brgyad 'byung po sogs bla gshed/

tshe len/ dbugs sdud/ mdangs 'phrog ban bon mu stegs byad ma mkhan po sogs kyis brkus shing 'phrog pa byad du bcug pa la sogs pa rnams dang*/ der ma zad brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams kyi dwangs bcud/ khyad par du grub pa'i bcud len dang tshe sring pa'i nus par ldan pa'i sman dang rin po che sogs kyi nus bcud/ g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can lha klu mi'i dbang po phyogs skyong sde brgyad/ mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub pa drang srong rig pa 'dzin pa sogs kyi tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang rdzu 'phrul bkrag mdangs/ lung rtogs kyi yon tan/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa nyan rang rnams kyi gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi'i rlan dang bcas pa'i rnam par sems can sogs la gnod pa med par bung bas sbrang rtsi len pa'i tshul du bsdus te spyi bo'i bla ma rnams kyi sku la thim/ de rnams kyi sku las 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi kha dog lnga ldan gyi rgyun chad pa med par byon pas rang tshe lhar gsal ba'i dbu gtsug tshangs bug nas zhugs/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas tshe thung ba'i las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu nad gdon dus min 'chi ba dang bcas pa sangs kyis dag rang gi tshe dang bsod nams bla srog lus kyi 'byung khams nyams zad gud pa thams cad pad+mo rnyid par chun bran pa bzhin gsos/ grub pa'i bcud len myong bas kyang mi dpog pa gnyug ma'i sgo gsum mgon po tshe lha'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rjer bzhugs pa'i rang bzhin lhun grub kyi yon tan skad cig la gsos btab ste 'chi med rdo rje ye shes dwangs ma'i skur gyur/ ba spu'i khung bu tshun bdud rtsi'i zil pa phrom mer nyi ma bye bas cha tsam yang mi bsgrun pa'i gzi 'od rab tu rgyas pas tshe bdud log 'dren sogs kyis lta bar yang mi bzod pa'i mthu thob par bsams zhing gshis ma grub pa stong pa nyid du cham me/

mdangs ma 'gags pa lha'i skur lam me ba'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug rang bzhin yongs shes kyi ngang nas sngags bzla/ yig rnying gi dngos bstan de tsam yin yang spros pa la dga' na bla dang tshe dang srog gi yi ge la sogs pa'i rnam pa dang*/ 'byung ba sa'i bcud bdud rtsi ser po/ chu'i bcud dkar po/ me'i bcud dmar po/ rlung gi bcud ljang gu/ nam mkha'i bcud sngon po/ yang na yig rnying las 'byung ba bzhi ma gtogs ma bshad pas nam mkha' logs su ma phye yang rung zhing*/ de ltar na chu'i khams sngon por 'thad/ mchan/ skye 'gro'i tshe bsod/ 'phags pa'i byin rlabs bcas gong bzhin bsdu bya sde tshan rigs khams re la sdud byed 'od zer de dang 'tshams pa spro thengs re byas nas so sor bsdu bstim gyis bdud rtsi 'bebs dmigs byas kyang legs char 'gyur/ shin tu spros pa la mi dga' na gtso bor rang bzhin yongs shes 'chi med gnyug ma'i gnas lugs kyi ngang nas bzlas pas kyang rung*/ de ltar thun rer bzlas pa gang 'gro byas rjes thun bsdu ba na dbyangs gsal zhabs btags ma gsum gyis sngags nus brtan par byas/ tshe 'gugs lugs 'dir yig rnying las ma bshad pas ma byas kyang chog cing*/ byed par spro na/ bcom ldan mgon po sogs byang gter lcags sdong ma ltar ram/ dkyus ltar byed/ tshe 'gugs kyi dmigs pa/ rang lhar gsal ba dang spyi bo'i bla ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dang*/ 'byung ba lnga la dbang bsgyur ba'i tshe 'gugs kyi lha mo dkar/ ser/ dmar/ ljang*/ mthing ba'i mdog can mda' dang*/ lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu thogs pa che chung ma nges pa nyi zer gyi rdul ltar spros pas nam mkhas gar khyab kyi snod bcud 'byung khams la khyab/ 'chi bdag srog gshed/ bla rkun rnams spa bskongs shing tshar bcad de/ rang gi srog ces bzhon pa'i rlung dang*/ yid ces de'i bzhon pa can gyi shes pa dang*/

tshe zhes rlung sems kyi 'phel 'grib las chags 'jig byed pa dang*/ bla zhes de dag gi bag chags kyi rang gzugs srog chags la sogs pa'i rnam par shar ba gang dag yar zhing 'khyams pa sde brgyad 'byung pos khyer ba ma lus pa a dang nṛ la sogs pa'i yig 'bru dang*/ bla gzugs kyi srog chags 'od zer bdud rtsi sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan bkra shis rdzas rtags la sogs pa'i rnam par bsdus shing bkug ste snying ga'i tshe rten dang sgrub rdzas rnams la bstims pas/ bla tshe nyams pa thams cad sor chud cing 'chi med kyi dngos grub thob/ sgrub rdzas rnams kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos la tshigs mtshams su mda' dar g.yob pa sogs spyi dang 'dra/ thun thams cad kyi mtha' 'am spros pa la mi dga' na snga thun gyi mthar bcom ldan 'das la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ byin rlabs dkyus bzhin bya/ 'dir 'phrul dga'i lha'i tshul du bdag mdun dbyer med nyid la 'bul ba yin pas gtor mgron spyan 'dren ma dgos/ lha rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gyi bcud drangs te gsol bar bsams la rdo rje thal mo kha phye mthar se gol gtogs shing rtsa sngags la gtor sngags btags pa lan bdun nam gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod cing nang mchod mtheb srin gyis gtor la phul/ 'jig rten 'dren pas bstod/ 'chi med tshe yi sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ skabs 'di'am chos srung ye shes dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor 'bul rnams zin pa'i rjes gang yang rung bar spro na yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ spyi bo'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams yas rim bzhin gcig la gcig bsdus nas mthar bla ma thams cad 'dus pa'i 'od kyi gong bu rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i tshe rten thig le dkar po la thim pas thig le de nyid gsal zhing 'tsher ba yod med rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das pa/

bskal pa'i me chu rlung gis kyang gzhom gzhig cung zad kyang mi nus pa'i rtag brtan g.yung drung gi rang bzhin la sems dar cig gtad/ mthar tshe rten dang lha sku'i gsal snang yang mi dmigs pa gnas lugs bsal bzhag med pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag de las rang tshe lha'i skur langs/ snang grags thams cad lha sngags kyi rang bzhin du bltas te dge bsngo shis brjod mdor bsdus byas nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug 'jig rten pa'i gtor bsngo ni lcags zam pa'i brgyud pa rang rkang 'dzin pa rnams phrin las myur mgyogs rjes 'brang bcas mthong brgyud ltar gtong zhing*/ gzhan de ltar mi shes pa'am mi nus pas rang lugs kyi chos srung spyi bye brag gi gtor bsngo gang dgos mthar/ bde mchog las byung ba'i mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma spyi bzhin gtong ba phyag len du mdzad/ lugs snga ma ltar na 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma dmar zlum pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba gcig gam gnyis bsham dgos pa bcas gsham gyi skabs su dran par bya/ gang ltar yang chos srung 'jig rten pa'i gtor bsngo dgong mo'am srod kyi thun mthar btang bas chog gi thun thams cad la gtong mi dgos so// bcom ldan 'das la gtor 'bul thun re bzhin byed na gtor ma dang mchod pa zhal gso/ mchod pa byin rlabs bcas kyang thun re'i mgor bya dgos shing*/ ci ste gtor bsngo mi byed na 'dir bdag bskyed la mchod pa 'bul ba med pas de dag bor bas khyab/ spros med bdag bskyed kher rkyang la brten na sgrub rdzas kyi gshom dang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs gtor chog ci'ang mi dgos te 'di ni bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i spros med kyi tshe sgrub yin pas rtsa ba'i yig rnying las de dag ma bshad pa'i phyir ro// mtshams kyi spang blang la sogs pa ni gsang ba spyi'i 'gros las shes phyir 'dir ma smros la/ bzlas dmigs sogs phal cher mngon rtogs nyid bklags pas 'grub mod kyi blo gsar rnams go bde phyir ci rigs pa gong du bkrol zin/

byings la ma grags pa'i zab gnad bla ma rnams tshe rten la bstim pa 'di gsung rgyun zhal shes ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po'i zhal slob kun dga' dpal 'byor gyi zin bris las bshad pa ltar 'dir bris pa yin/ tshe sgrub gzhan ltar na tshe rten de nyid yi ge a dkar po'am nṛs mtshan par bsgoms kyang rung ngo*// tshul des grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag bzhi'am 'bru 'bum bcu cha'i kha skong bcas thems pa'am/ rtags bsnyen rab dngos nyams rmi lam du bla ma tshe lha'i zhal mthong ba lha sku'i gsal snang reg mthong gi mtshan ma grub pa sogs dang*/ tha ma'ang nyi zla shar ba dang*/ shing 'bras rnyed cing longs spyod pa sogs rmi lam dge ba'i mtshan ma mthong na bsnyen pa las su rung ba yin la/ tha na bdun phrag gcig tsam ci nus su 'bad pas kyang dus min gyi 'chi ba zhi ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pas de yang nan tan du bya ba kho na'o// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi puṇ+ye dz+nyā na ā yuḥsid+dhi dzaḥ zhes pa 'di kho na yin te hūm̐ dzaḥzer ba dang*/ ā yuḥpaṇ+ye dz+nyā na sid+dhi zer ba sogs tshe sgrub gzhan dang rigs 'gre'i bsre lhad zhugs pa yin pas shes par byos shig lugs 'di la bsnyen pa'i mtha' la sbyin sreg mdzad pa'i phyag len sngon chad cher ma dar yang*/ 'grub na legs pa'i yan lag yin la/ byed par spro na rigs mthun bla med kyi sbyin sreg 'jug bde gang yang rung ba'i ye shes pa'i lha sngags bla ma tshe lha nyid du bsgyur bas 'grub/ de yang kha skong gi tshe til dang zhi ba'i spel tshig las kyi ngar 'dogs na dūrba dang tshe rgyas pa'i spel tshig gtso bor bya dgos pas gnad shes par bya/ nam bya ba'i dus ni dngos grub blang ba'i gong 'og mtshams kyi khongs nyid du'am/ skabs gzhan du'ang bkag pa med la/ bsnyen mtshams ji ltar byed pa'i dam bca' mthar son nas dngos grub blang ba ni/

thor thun zhig gi mthar bcom ldan 'das la gtor ma nges can du 'bul zhing*/ 'dod gsol gyi mthar/ spro na tshe dbang sbyor dngos mjug gsum bdag 'jug tu blang*/ bsdu na/ snang ba mtha' yas sogs gsol 'debs sngags bcas brjod cing tshe bum lhar gsal ba spyi bor blangs la tshe bcud bsdu bstim gyi dmigs ba sngar bshad pa ltar bya ba nyid la bdag 'jug gi don tshang bas de ltar byas pa'i rjes bla ma rnams rang la bstims nas mnyam par bzhag tshe bum sngar shul du bsgrig lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i sgrub rdzas myong ba tsam gyis 'chi med 'grub par bltas la sngags bzla bzhin du tshe chang la longs spyad/ de rjes bsngo smon shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa byed/ chos srung gi gtor bsngo gtor ma skyong ba sogs ni gong gi tshe lha'i gtor bsngo'i rjes sam skabs gzhan gang bder byas pas rung la/ tshogs mchod byed par spro na'ang tshe lha'i gtor bsngo tshar ba man chad skabs gang 'os su sbyar bas 'thus te/ lcags zam rang lugs dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i nye brgyud rigs lnga 'chi med mchog sbyin ltar bya ba'am/ byang gter thugs sgrub lta bu nas blangs kyang mi 'thad pa med/ tho 'grol sogs spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ mtshams grol ba'i thog mar mig nyi zla'i phyogs su lta stangs byed pa tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa'i rten 'brel du bshad do// gsum pa zhugs 'bras rang gzhan la phan gdags pa la gnyis/ ril bu sgrub pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ bsnyen pa'i skabs su thog mar tshe ril bsgril yod na de nyid dang*/ med na gong du bshad pa ltar bcud len gyi sman sna la rje grub thob chen po'i tshe ril gyi phabs rgyun gtso bor gyur pa'i chos 'di pa'i brgyud pa sogs bla ma gong ma'i tshe rdzas sel med sbyar ba'i tshe ril rtsi dmar po gsol pa ril chags 'them par byas la rin po che'i bum par blugs/

dar dmar gyi rdul khebs dang mgul chings kyis spras te stegs bu'i g.yas su bzhugs/ gzungs thag gdags/ gzhan tshe gtor dbus/ tshe chang g.yon sogs bsham tshul bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin la/ ngag 'don gyi rim pa ni/ yig cha gang la brten yang rung mod 'dir skabs su bab pas lugs dbang chog rdo rje'i rgya mdud ltar bya ba la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma chab kyis bran te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang ba nas/ de kun lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol zhes 'dod gsol gyi bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par btang*/ mdun gyi sgrub rdzas gtso bo ril bu la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa bai ḍūr+ya'i rang bzhin rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba/ bkod pa legs pas mdzes shing lhun stug pa'i dbus su rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khrir rin po che'i bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du ril bu rnams re re bzhin yi ge hrīḥdamar po re re yongs su gyur ba las/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sogs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmadun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim zhes kha bsgyur te/ gsol 'debs kyi byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol bar dang*/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ gzungs thag nas bzung la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ gzungs thag la brgyud nas song ste bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan sogs nas/ rgyun chad med par byon pas bar gong ltar dang*/ ril bu tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ ba spu'i khung bu tshun bdud rtsi zil pa phrom mer nyi ma bye bas cha tsam yang mi bsgrun pa'i gzi 'od rab tu rgyas pas tshe bdud log 'dren sogs kyis lta bar yang mi bzod pa'i mthu thob par bsam zhing gshis ma grub pa stong nyid du cham me/

mdangs ma 'gags pa lha skur lam me ba'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug rang bzhin yongs shes kyi ngang nas sngags bzla/ de ltar thun rer bzlas pa gang 'gro byas rjes thun bsdu ba na dbyangs gsal zhabs btags ma lan gsum gyis sngags byin brtan par byas/ sgrub grogs yod na bza' btung dang spyod lam sogs kyi tshe gzungs thag res mos su bzung la bzlas pa rgyun mi chad par bya/ tshe bcud bsdu bstim gyi dmigs pa gong ltar gyis/ dkar mo mgyogs ma sogs kyi tshe 'gugs dang*/ mdun gyi mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs la/ spro na 'jig rten khams ni sogs tshigs bcad dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da'i bar 'don pa bsgyur te ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta brjod pas phyi mchod/ nang mchod 'bru gsum gyis dbul/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs kyis bstod/ de nas gtor mar chab bran te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsogs nas/ bsngo smon bkra shis rgyas par brjod pa'i bar gong bzhin bya/ ril bu'i lha sgrub pa ma grol bar brtan bzhugs bya/ thun phyi ma rnams la bum lha sngar yod gsal gdab kyi tshul du bskyed/ de lta bu'i sgo nas ril bu las 'od dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri bzang po 'thul ba dang*/ rgya cher 'phel ba sogs rtags mthong ba'i bar ram/ zhag bdun sogs su bsgrubs te grol ba'i nyin rjes chog bar sngar ltar dang*/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas 'od du zhu mgon po tshe dpag med la thim pa nas byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin 'od du zhu/ ril bu tshe dpag med gsal ba la thim/ de'ang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rnam par ltems gyis zhu ste ril bu dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsams la/ ye dhar brgya rtsa dang*/ dbyangs gsal zhabs btags ma grangs mang gis byin rlabs brtan par byas la/ ril bu dar sogs kyi snod du bkur sti dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol/

rjes dge ba bsngo/ smon lam bkra shis rgyas par brjod par bya'o// de nas sgrub pa'i dngos gzhi bdag 'jug gi sgo nas dngos grub blang ba'i tshul ni/ ril bu bsgrub pa dang*/ bsnyen pa grub pa gang ltar yang mjug tu/ bsham chog de nyid la mchod gtor ci 'byor dang*/ maṇ+ḍal/ bgegs bskrad chas/ 'bebs rdzas sogs 'du byas la/ ngag 'don yig cha gong ltar gyi sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams/ bdag bskyed 'dod gsol gyi bar song nas/ mdun gyi sgrub rdzas rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa sogs nas/ yongs su gyur pa las/ de nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim zhes kha bsgyur te/ tshe dang ye shes 'chi med dngos grub stsol// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa bsang sbyang nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bar gong ril sgrub skabs bzhin byas la/ de nas bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/ zhu yon maṇ+ḍal nas brtsams te/ cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// bar mtshams sbyor gyi tshig rnams dor te dbang chog dkyus ma nyid brjod pas 'thus/ rjes kyi mchod pa zhal gsos te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsogs nas/ bsngo smon bkra shis bar rgyas par brjod pas don 'grub cing*/ de tsam mi nus na/ grol rgyu'i thun gyi mjug tu gtang rag gi mchod pa rgya cher phul nas tshe gtor dang*/ tshe ril lhar gsal ba rang gi spyi bor byon/ de'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ljang bzhi'i thig le a nṛ hūm̐ hrīḥs mtshan pa rang rang gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob/ tshe dpag med kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyis byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ sngags kyi mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ wā ka a bhiṣiñca āḥtsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/

sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes brjod la rang gi gnas bzhir gtugs/ lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i sgrub rdzas myong ba tsam gyis 'chi med 'grub par bltas la/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang*/ bkra shis rgyas pa byas nas thog mar tshe ril dang*/ tshe chang dngos grub kyi bgo skal du myangs pas lus 'chi med bdud rtsis dkar ltem gyis gang ba'i dwang ma'i dwang ma/ bcud kyi yang bcud thams cad rang gi snying gi dbus na nyi zla kha sbyor gyi nang du srog mi 'gyur ba'i rten hrīḥyig tshe'i thig le dang bcas pa la thim pas sgo gsum bkrag mdangs gzi byin nus stobs 'bar zhing*/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad gong nas gong du rgyas par bsam/ de nas rim gyis gzhan la byin pas thams cad kyang myang ba tsam gyis 'chi med grub pa'i gnas la sbyor ba'i sa bon gdab par bya'o// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ 'jam mgon kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i dbang chog 'chi med rdo rje'i rgya mdud dam/ yang na bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i dbang chog ltar bya'o// yang 'di'i sgo nas gzhan gyi tshe sgrub byed na lugs 'dir lhar bskyed pa'i sngon du bsgrub bya de nyid yid la dran par byas la/ bsgrub bya'i snang ba de yang rang sems kyi rtsal snang las logs na med pas/ rang dang bsgrub bya 'dres zin pa de nyid lhar bskyed pa la tshe bcud bsdu bstim bya zhing*/ mthar spros pa la dga' na tshe dbang bskur/ de min kyang sgrub rdzas bsgrub byar gtad la tshe bum spyi bor bzhag tshe ril tshe chang la longs spyod du gzhug pa ni khyad par ro// 'di nyid rje bla ma mkhyen brtse'i zhabs de nyid kyis lcags zam pa bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub kyi gsung la sa skya'i lugs la'ang khyab pa'i gsal byed mdzad pa nyid dngos gzhi'i 'gor 'phro lus gyur pa man chod de nyid kyi gsungs sor bzhag la/

sgrub pa'i skabs kyi gsal byed bcas blo gter dbang pos zhal skong du bris pa'i dge bas rje 'di'i sprul pa'i zla snang 'char bas gtsos bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams zhabs pad brtan cing*/ bdag sogs 'gro kun dus min 'chi bdag gi 'jigs pa las thar te/ mgon po tshe mtha' yas pa'i go 'phang la myur du reg pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dzā gā dā yuḥpuṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ kurban+tu/ maṅga laṃ// ༈ /tshe sgrub nye brgyud kyi sgo nas brtan bzhugs 'bul ba'i cho ga nye bar bsdus pa 'chi med grub pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ 'chi med grub pa'i ye shes sku// bla ma tshe dpag med mgon zhabs// btud nas bstan 'dzin skyes bu la// brtan bzhugs 'bul ba'i cho ga dbye// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ dus tshes dge bar gnas khang bkod pas mdzes par dkon mchog spyi dang*/ tshe dpag med kyi rten bkram pa'i phugs su bla ma'i bzhugs khri la stan dkar rdo rje dang g.yung drung gi ri mo can gding*/ nye logs ci rigs par dbang chog las ji ltar 'byung ba'i mdun bskyed kyi rten mchod gtor dang bcas pa/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs mnga' 'bul gyi chas/ maṇ+ḍal dang rol mo'i bye brag sogs 'og tu mkho ba rnams 'du byas nas/ sngon gtor gtong ba dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs nas bzung ste/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar dbang chog ltar dang*/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bskyed bzlas spyi ltar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ brtan bzhugs 'bul yul de nyid spos dang rol mo sogs bkur sti dang bcas gdan drangs te khri la bzhugs su gsol/ sbyong ba gsum spyi ltar sngon du 'gro bas khrus gsol dang bcas pa'i mthar/ brtan bzhugs 'bul yul/ a mri tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas yul snod bcud thams cad bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/

mdzes shing lhun stug pa'i dbus su rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdamar po yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sogs nas/ mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar ba'i skur gyur ba'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i so so'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i steng gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku lus la sib sib thim pas 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes par gyur/ rtsa sngags mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ā be sha ya ā āḥ zhes brjod cing spos rol dang bcas byin dbab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'gro kun rjes su skyong*// sogs brgyud 'debs kyi mthar/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku lus las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe yar ba dang 'thor ba dang nyams chags su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe dpal bsod nams/ sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos srung sogs 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bcud dang dge mtshan rnams bsdus/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la thim/ slar yang de dag gi sku las 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub brnyes par gyur/ ces brjod cing*/ rtsa sngags dang spos rol bya/ de nas tshe bum bteg la gong gi dmigs pa dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥ

snang ba mtha' yas sogs nas/ thang stong rgyal po gsol btab bslu ba med// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs brjod cing phul la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs la brten nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe mi shigs pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig /mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig /mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig /'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes par gyur cig /ces dang*/ sngags brjod cing me tog 'thor/ rol mo'i sgra sbyar/ de bzhin du tshe ril/ bkra shis tshe brtan sogs nas/ de ring khyod kyi gsol bar bgyi// 'di gsol bcom ldan tshe dpag med// zhal mthong 'gyur bar gdon mi za// zhes dang*/ sngags brjod cing 'bul/ thabs kyi rdzas tshe'i ril bu phul ba la brten nas thabs bde ba chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba rdo rje tshe'i dngos grub brnyes par gyur cig sngags rol bya/ 'chi med tshe yi dpal la sogs brjod cing tshe chang phul/ shes rab kyi rdzas tshe'i bdud rtsi phul ba la brten nas shes rab stong pa nyid cis kyang mi shigs pa rdo rje tshe'i dngos grub brnyes par gyur cig sngags rol bya/ de nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad bsang sbyang byin brlab spyi ltar byas la/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la sogs nas/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'ang me long gi rdzas la brten nas zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtshor brtan cing*/ shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po ste/ sogs brjod la/ de bzhin du yungs kar gyi bar 'gres shes par bya/ spro na bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rgyal srid sna bdun sogs kyang 'bul/

slar yang spyi bo'i steng gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams rim gyis 'od du zhu nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku lus la thim pas sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'chi med tshe mtha' yas pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ lha dang drang srong bden tshig grub pa rnams kyis kyang me tog gi char 'bebs shing*/ shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pas kyang mnga' gsol bar gyur/ shis brjod rgyas pa'i mthar me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo bya/ spro na brjod bya phun sum tshogs shing*/ rjod byed rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa'i zhal bzhes zhu ba'i bshad pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal gyi rnam gzhag ji ltar rigs pa zhu zhing*/ gang ltar yang maṇ+ḍal rgyas par 'bul/ bla ma dam pa de rang gi brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs dmigs bsal yod na dang*/ spyi 'gro'i brtan bzhugs bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam dang bcas lhag bsam rnam par dag pas mgrin gcig tu gdab/ gsum pa ni/ kha na ma tho ba spangs pa'i dga' ston rgya cher spel/ mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog dkyus ltar dang*/ legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa bsgrigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// srid 'dir phan bde'i sgo gcig pu// bstan pa'ang de nyid 'dzin la rag /de phyir brtan bzhugs cho ga'i tshul// spel 'dis don gnyis lhun grub shog /ces bla ma zhi khro'i tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster dang rjes su 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga snying por dril ba'i le'u tshan no// zhes pa 'di ni rje grub thob chen po ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rnam par snang ba mañju gho ṣa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'o// ༈ /nye brgyud tshe rta zung 'brel gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'chi med rdo rje'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru be/ 'chi med thog ma'i mgon po snang mtha' yas// 'chi med ye shes sbyin mdzad tshe dpag med// 'chi med rdo rje'i skur bzhengs rta mchog dpal// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// 'chi med rig 'dzin mchog brnyes pad+ma 'byung*// 'chi med grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong pa// 'chi med gnyug ma'i gar mkhan kun spangs rjer// gsol ba 'debs so=

/'chi med gnas lugs mngon gyur grol mchog zhabs// 'chi med bdud rtsis rab dgyes nyi zla'i mtshan// 'chi med mchog sbyin dbang phyug dpal bzang la// gsol ba= 'chi med brnyes pa ngag dbang chos grags dang*// 'chi med rgyal ba'i sras po ā nan+da// 'chi med mgon po kun dga' bsod nams la// gsol ba= /'chi med 'jam dpal rdo rje bsod nams dbang*// 'chi med dga' ston spel mkhas maṅgalaṃ// 'chi med rigs kyi thig le puṇ+ye'i mtshan// gsol ba= /'chi med grub pa kun dga' blo gros dang*// 'chi med rgyal sar 'dzegs mkhas nam mkha'i mtshan// 'chi med rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba= /'chi med gdams pa'i smin grol zab mo yis// 'chi med tshe dang ye shes mchog stsol ba// 'chi med rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba= /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// skyabs su 'gro dang byang chub sems bskyed nas// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs pas// sku gnyis ngal 'tsho cir yang rgyas par shog /khyad par snang srid bde chen zhing khams su// yongs shar rang nyid tshe dpag med mgon skur// gsal ba'i spyi bor rtsa brgyud bla mar bcas// snang stong zung 'jug chen por 'char gyur cig /slar yang gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// thugs srog nyin mor byed pa'i 'dzum dkar gyis// srid dang zhi ba'i tshe bcud ut+pal// dbang du bgyid pa'i dge mtshan grub par shog /de las bdud rtsi gaṅga'i klung rgyun ltar// babs pas bdag gzhan phung khams kun khyab nas// nad gdon sdig sgrib dus min 'chi ba kun// sbyangs te 'chi med rig 'dzin grub gyur cig /rtsa brgyud bla ma rim gyis 'od zhu nas// rang la thim pas byin rlabs zla shel gsar// 'du 'bral med par snying dbus bzhugs pa las// phan bde'i snang bas rtag tu mdzes par shog /ces tshe rta zung 'brel gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa 'chi med rdo rje'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di'ang skal bzang mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos e waṃ thar pa rtser mdzes byed snron zla'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis pa lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor 'char ba'i dus tshes dge bar gsol ba btab pa sid+dhi rastu//
